falsifier: The design's item 3 (Connections promotes/demotes) would have shipped backwards on this product's own primary dev/demo pack if not caught: keying the decision on sources.demonstrated (fixture-generation count) rather than sources.granted (real-adapter count) demotes Connections on template-city, which is granted 0 but demonstrates 6 fixture kinds by design (it is the public DEMO pack, not the honest-empty one -- a second shipped pack, granted 0 and demonstrated 0, is the actual honest-empty regression target). Caught by live-checking /api/city-identity against the local dev server before trusting the assumption, fixed to key on granted before it reached a PR. Separately, CI's a11y job caught a second, different defect the local unit-test suite could not see: the first implementation of the tile-as-link pattern (a .metric div covered by a full-bleed, absolutely-positioned sibling anchor) made axe unable to SETTLE a color-contrast background for the text underneath it (bgOverlap) -- a positioned box paints above in-flow inline content regardless of DOM order, so the overlay was wrong structurally, not just unlucky. Fixed by making each tile the anchor itself (no overlap possible), re-verified locally (a11y gate PASSED, 0 new unresolved) and on CI (conclusion SUCCESS) before merge.
